title: Appspine plugin inventory
description: appspine.plugins.json — the declarative list of plugin instances an App runs. Owned by @appspine/plugin-cli and reviewed as a diff (051 decision 10). Holds no secret values and no package versions: pnpm-lock.yaml is the only truth for versions, and credentials come from the operator's environment.

presets.description: Preset packages whose plugin lists are expanded into this inventory. Declared here from v1 so an inventory written today stays readable once PL2-08 ships preset expansion; until then a non-empty list is rejected rather than silently ignored.

plugin.description: Package name (@appspine/health-check) or bare plugin id (health-check).

instanceId.description: Stable per-install identity. Renaming one is a migration, not a config tweak.

required.description: true means a lifecycle failure aborts boot. false is only legal when the manifest declares an optionalFailurePolicy.

configRef.description: Dotted path into the App's runtime config. Must match the manifest's configSchema.configRef. A reference, never a value — and never a secret.
